Subject: Pilot wrap: Tilt Commerce POC results & quick advocacy ask

Hi Lena / Sam —

Thanks again for partnering with us on the two-week POC. We pushed the workload you handed us through our dedicated runtime and ran the 30k checkout-lookup sessions you shared. Early highlight bullets from our side (summary attached):

- Average 95th-percentile latency (user-facing) dropped from ~420ms (baseline) to 110ms when using smart routing + small-KV cache.
- Token cost per session reduced ~62% versus the untuned baseline using our batching + quantization profile (details in token_usage_breakdown.csv).
- Throughput sustained at 180 reqs/s during the promo stress window; no dropped requests and average CPU/GPU utilization within expected ranges.

I attached a one-page results PDF and the token breakdown CSV for your records.

Quick ask: would Tilt be comfortable providing a two-line quote and a 10-minute call with someone on your product/ops team that we could record (audio only) for an internal case snippet? We plan to use a single-sentence blurb on the landing page and a short clip in a 60-second customer highlight. If you're open, suggested timeline is this week or early next week — we can work around your calendar.

If you prefer, a two-line email reply with permission plus the one-sentence quote below is enough: 

"Tilt Commerce saw a major responsiveness improvement and cost savings after integrating with Redwood Inference during our pilot."

Totally understand if legal or procurement needs signoff — happy to route through whatever process you prefer.

Thanks again — big fan of the Tilt product and appreciate the partnership.

Best,
Nikhil
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: tilt-poc-results-summary.pdf (1 page), token_usage_breakdown.csv (3 rows)
